title: TIE-BAND-DIVERSITY REPLICATED — uniform gen-max tie-break alone converts 2/3 of the hard class (29/37), no archive, no retention
directive: Upgrade exp019's POST-HOC tie-aware mechanism read to a run-tested mechanism: flip ONLY the gen-max tie-break rule (uniform sampling among exact-fitness ties vs incumbent-first) on the exact exp016 champion-local lane; archive and retention absent by construction.

engine.name: micromoth
engine.note: matches the import-baseline manifest pin on main; runner executes against the qcells lab package (labs/qcells), same engine family as exp016-exp019

seeds.panel: easy control 13 (harness sanity, expected crossing in BOTH arms) + hard class 29/31/37 (the discriminating comparison); root_seed = root value, identical for paired arms

question: Is tie-band diversity ALONE sufficient for the hard-root crossing — i.e. does the exp019 post-hoc TIE-BAND-DIVERSITY read on roots 29/37 survive as a run mechanism when the only change is the gen-max tie-break rule?
design: Champion-local skeleton, the exact exp016 lane (targets 000/111, mode balance, n_qubits 3, gate budget 6, jitter-dropped restrict replace/indel, one-move classed cloud, pop 16, gens 12), birth skeleton [[h,0],[cx,0,1]] in every run. Two arms, arm the ONLY difference between paired runs: ARM-INCUMBENT = max() first-wins (train ties freeze on the incumbent, exact exp014 semantics); ARM-TIESAMPLE = all candidates at exact gen-max fitness (exact float equality) sampled uniformly via the run rng, extra draw part of the arm definition. Single champion carried forward — NO archive, NO non-champion retention; verify gate unchanged. Guard: exp001 default lane (2-qubit |01>, targets (01,), mode any, root 7) reproduced byte-identical through the SAME instrumented loop BEFORE any results were written; the loop's default tie behavior is incumbent, so the guard pins shared machinery; the tiesample arm diverges by definition and is not guard-covered (stated in the pre-registration).
pre_run_pin: Interpretation pinned BEFORE running: INCUMBENT must reproduce exp014's class (cross 13, 0/3 hard); TIESAMPLE >=1 hard-root crossing that INCUMBENT missed -> TIE-BAND-DIVERSITY REPLICATED (exp019 post-hoc read upgrades to run mechanism, still N/M per ROOT-LOTTERY, not a law); TIESAMPLE 0/3 -> TIE SAMPLING ALONE INSUFFICIENT (archive advantage NOT explained by tie-band diversity; exp019 assembly verdict stands on retention alone).

results.verdict: TIE-BAND-DIVERSITY REPLICATED: tiesample crossed 2/3 hard roots ([29, 37] @0.4824) that incumbent missed; incumbent reproduced exp014's class exactly (0/3 hard at the 0.2422 plateau, easy 13 crossed 0.4824); tiesample r31 peaked 0.3027 — per-root N/M per ROOT-LOTTERY, not a law. No archive, no retention: tie sampling alone converts 2/3 of the hard class.
results.guard_coverage_note: guard pins shared machinery on the default (incumbent tie) lane only; tiesample arm diverges by definition, stated pre-run

arms.tiesample: uniform rng.choice among exact-fitness gen-max ties

results.mechanism_read: exp019's post-hoc tie-aware read (29/37 TIE-BAND-DIVERSITY) upgrades to run-tested mechanism; r31 remains the resistant root (exp021 sealed follow-up in the qcells lab: 3/8 salted streams crossed r31 — a per-stream ROOT-LOTTERY draw, not a wall)
results.comparator_exp014_reproduced_in_arm: incumbent arm = exp014 champion-local semantics on the overlapping panel: 0/3 hard roots at the 0.2422 plateau, easy root crossed — the harness reproduces the comparator class live in-arm

cross_receipts.exp014: comparator class live in-arm: champion-local 0/3 hard (MERGED PR #19); no pin depends on exp014 files beyond the embedded comparator block
cross_receipts.exp016: the lane and the hybrid crossing this ablation decomposes (MERGED PR #22)
cross_receipts.exp018: the desert premise: freeze upstream of selection on 29/31/37 (MERGED PR #24)
cross_receipts.exp019: the post-hoc mechanism read this run upgrades (PR #25 Casey-gated at seal time — read cited from sealed artifacts with named provenance; this receipt anchors only on merged receipts for its load-bearing pins)
cross_receipts.exp012: ROOT-LOTTERY doctrine (MERGED PR #17): 2/3-vs-0/3 is an N/M rate read, never a mechanism law

honest_limits: N/M, NOT A LAW: 2/3 hard roots (29/37) under tiesample vs 0/3 incumbent is a root-disjoint draw of 3 roots per exp012 ROOT-LOTTERY doctrine; the mechanism claim is 'tie-band diversity is sufficient to convert SOME of the hard class', not 'the archive's advantage is tie-breaking'.

r31 UNEXPLAINED BY THIS RUN: tiesample r31 peaked 0.3027 and still did not cross; the per-stream ROOT-LOTTERY follow-up (exp021: 3/8 salted streams crossed r31) is sealed in the qcells lab, not in this receipt.

GUARD COVERAGE STATED: the guard reproduces exp001 on the default (incumbent) tie lane only; the tiesample arm diverges from the guard lane by definition and is not guard-covered — stated pre-run, not discovered post-hoc.
The extra rng draw in the tiesample arm is part of the arm definition (documented stream divergence); arms are not draw-matched beyond the shared birth/root/lane, by design pin.
